title: Yellowed Buttery Irish Potato Skillet
description: A buttery and energizing Irish dish featuring vanilla bean paste and a mirepoix base, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This egg-free friendly recipe is cooked to perfection in an iron teppan.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan over medium heat.
Add 2 tablespoons of butter to the teppan and let it melt.
Add the diced onions, carrots, and celery to the teppan and cook until they are tender.
Add the diced potatoes to the teppan and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the vanilla bean paste, salt, and black pepper to the teppan and stir to combine.
Continue cooking the potato mixture for an additional 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter to the teppan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the butter is melted and the potatoes are golden brown.
